# Accuracy analysis: c-python-cpython-autogenerated-test-case

Measured 2026-10-13 on main 3f7c2b64 (`benchmark_optimal_solutions`, `painting_failure_census`,
`mismatch_detail_for_fixture`, `painting_disagreement_detail`). The engine changes; re-measure
before relying on these numbers.

## Numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Mapping mismatches | 52 (33 visible) of 200904 nodes, 200904 graded, N:M floor 0 visible |
| Painting, Minimal | 269 bytes wrong of 1059875: renderer 58, matcher 211 |
| Painting, Full | 1137 bytes wrong of 1059875: renderer 936, matcher 262 |
| Ground-truth invariant violations | none |

## The change

`Modules/_testinternalcapi/test_cases.c.h` is generated. It is the test-interpreter copy of
`Python/generated_cases.c.h`, the sister fixture `c-python-cpython-autogenerated`. It differs from
that file by three `Test_EvalFrame_*++;` lines and the header comment, and it has the same hunk at
the same line numbers. The commit regenerates `TARGET(CALL_INTRINSIC_1)` (lines 2985-3001 before,
2985-3006 after) as two micro-op blocks, `// _CALL_INTRINSIC_1 { ... }` and
`// _POP_TOP { ... }`. Most statements move into the first block with 4 more columns of
indentation. The stack-pointer bookkeeping changes: `stack_pointer += -1;`, both
`ASSERT_WITHIN_STACK_BOUNDS(__FILE__, __LINE__);` and `stack_pointer += 1;` go, and `_POP_TOP`
gets `_PyFrame_SetStackPointer(...)`, `PyStackRef_XCLOSE(value);` and
`stack_pointer = _PyFrame_GetStackPointer(frame);`. The tree ground truth has the same 328
entries as the sister fixture's. The mapping mismatches are the same 52, and they are analysed the
same way below.

## Mapping

All 52 mismatches are in this one function body. There are two groups, and they depend on each
other.

- **Which `stack_pointer = _PyFrame_GetStackPointer(frame);` is kept (18 visible, 10
  invisible).** The before side has this statement twice: at line 2989, after the `res_o` call,
  and at line 2994, after `PyStackRef_CLOSE(value);`. The after side has it at line 2992 (first
  block, after the `res_o` call) and line 3005 (end of `_POP_TOP`, after `PyStackRef_XCLOSE`).
  The ground truth deletes lines 2989-2993 as one block and maps line 2994 to line 2992. It then
  builds line 3005 from `stack_pointer += 1;` (line 3000): `+=` -> `=` match_but_not_identical,
  `1` deleted, the call inserted. omnidiff keeps both copies, by two passes: line 2989 -> line 2992 comes from
  `APTED("large_flat_subtree")` (7 visible, 4 invisible), the same positional pass as the next
  group, and line 2994 -> line 3005 from `MovedSubtree` (11 visible, 6 invisible). Both answers keep the statement order.
  omnidiff's keeps two identical statements matched where the ground truth deletes one copy and
  rebuilds the other from an unrelated assignment. The ground truth reads as one deleted block.
  `ambiguous`.
- **Leftover statements paired by position (15 visible, 9 invisible).** omnidiff pairs
  `stack_pointer += 1;` (line 3000) with `_PyFrame_SetStackPointer(frame, stack_pointer);` (line
  3003, `MatchButNotIdentical`, `+=` deleted). It also pairs
  `ASSERT_WITHIN_STACK_BOUNDS(__FILE__, __LINE__);` (line 3001) with `PyStackRef_XCLOSE(value);`
  (line 3004). Both pairings come from `APTED("large_flat_subtree")`
  (`diff/solve_large_flat_subtrees.rs`). The paired statements share only an identifier or
  punctuation. omnidiff also deletes the before `_PyFrame_SetStackPointer(frame,
  stack_pointer);` at line 2992, which is byte-identical to after line 3003. The ground truth
  deletes line 3001 and inserts lines 3003 and 3004. In this group omnidiff's pairing is the
  worse one: APTED pairs the unmatched statements by position, not by content. `matcher`.

Reasons for the "with children" mismatches re-read on 2026-10-13 after the test helper began printing them.

## Painting

Matcher-owned runs (absent when the human mapping is rendered):

- Minimal, 211 bytes. The `GetStackPointer` choice owns 131 bytes. Before line 2989 is
  None -> Delete (48). Before line 2994 is Move -> None (48). Most of after line 3005 is
  Move -> None (35). The positional pairings own 80 bytes: `+= ` on line 3000 (Delete -> Update,
  3), the ASSERT on line 3001 (Update/None -> Delete, 37), `stack_pointer` and `;` on line 3003
  (None -> Insert, 15), and `PyStackRef_XCLOSE(value);` on line 3004 (Update -> Insert, 25).
  `matcher` / `ambiguous`.
- Full, 231 real bytes. The same lines with indentation: 108 from the `GetStackPointer` choice
  (before line 2989, the indentation of after line 2992, after line 3005) and 123 from the
  positional pairings (before lines 3000-3001, after lines 3003-3004). The human mapping's own
  rendering also differs from omnidiff's on 30 more bytes (indentation of the `if (res_o ==
  NULL)` lines, two spaces on line 3005). There omnidiff's rendering happens to agree with the
  painting. This is why matcher_bytes is 262.

Renderer-owned runs (still there when the human mapping is rendered):

- Full, Move -> None, 874 bytes. Before lines 2985-2988 and 2994-2999, after lines 2988-2995,
  2997 and 3002. These statements are reparented into the new `{ }` blocks and indented 4 more
  columns. The Full renderer paints them Move, full lines including indentation. The Full
  painting leaves them unpainted. `renderer`.
- Full, 32 bytes, `stack_pointer += 1;` -> after line 3005. The painting moves the indentation
  and the spaces around `+=`. The renderer does not, and it paints the new 16-column indentation
  of line 3005 as unchanged. `renderer`.
- Minimal, Move -> None, 54 bytes. `stack_pointer[` of `stack_pointer[0] = res;` ->
  `stack_pointer[-1] = res;` (before line 2999, after line 3002), and `stack_pointer` of
  `stack_pointer += 1` -> after line 3005. These are the unchanged parts of updated statements
  that also moved. omnidiff paints them Move. The painting leaves them unpainted. `renderer`.
- Minimal, None -> Insert, 4 bytes. The new blocks' braces (after lines 2987, 2998, 3000 and
  3006). Minimal drops them as structural punctuation. The painting paints them. `renderer`.
  Here both paintings paint the first block's `}` (line 2998). The sister fixture's paintings do
  not, so Full has no `}` run here (1137 real bytes against 1150 there).

## Verdict

- Primary cause: `renderer`
- Other causes: `matcher`, `ambiguous`
- Where a fix would go: the Full rendering of nodes reparented into a new block (indentation-only
  shift painted Move) in `src/diff/text.rs`. Also the positional pairing of unrelated leftover
  statements under `APTED("large_flat_subtree")` (`diff/solve_large_flat_subtrees.rs`).
- Ground truth questionable: no. The tree mapping deletes the identical `stack_pointer =
  _PyFrame_GetStackPointer(frame);` at before line 2989 and rebuilds after line 3005 from
  `stack_pointer += 1;`. That is a defensible reading, not an inconsistency. The paintings are
  consistent here, unlike the sister fixture's split `{`/`}` pair.
